Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Ishaan - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Pallavi - 39 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Pallavi stands near him.]

Ishaan: "Today feels like a good day."

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Pallavi (surprised): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Smoke rises from the chimney.]

Ishaan: "Careful!"

[Ishaan lights a bonfire.]

Pallavi: "What a day to remember!"
